card.name: Section numbers in label headings
card.fires_on: The dot or digit inside a numbered subsection heading like 7.2 or 5.13, just before the heading title starts. It fires in drug-label section numbering after a sentence ends.

modes.label: Dot after section number
modes.description: The period after the main section number, before the subsection digit.

modes.label: Digit in subsection number
modes.description: The subsection digit after the period in a heading number.

card.plain: It marks the numbers in a label's section headings, like 5.13 or 7.2, just before the heading title.
